alt: House: 2026 alongside five earlier elections. House annual associations for 2016, 2018, 2020, 2022, 2024 and 2026. alt: Identity comparisons remain inconclusive in 2026. Selected documented Democratic incumbents only, on compatible district maps. The race comparison is Asian/Pacific Islander versus Black, not White versus minority or all nominees. There is no qualified atheist comparison. ACS controls describe residents, not voters; compatible 2026 district religious composition is unavailable. The nominal Muslim interval excludes zero but does not survive multiplicity correction.

alt: Missing identity evidence limits the 2026 comparison. All religion and race categories are shown, including zeros. Unknown Hispanic origin never supplies a non-Hispanic comparison group.

alt: Trait records add little predictive lift for 2026. Each feature is compared with a baseline on its own identical held-out candidates, not on a common sample across features. House samples range from 130 to 349; Senate samples from 8 to 23. Birth in state is exploratory. Small error differences are not a statistical test that one nominee type is better.

alt: 2026: partisan geography sets the starting point. All 408 eligible House and 29 Senate comparisons, including unresolved incumbency. House benchmarks use 2026 district maps; unqualified rounds and absent major-party nominees remain outside the plot.
